text:
maria_sales: Heads-up: FinEdge signed a short POC. They run HIPAA data and have three predictable market-open spikes (each ~3 min) to ~35k qps. Need recommended reserved commit + autoscale/burst approach + items to call out on security questionnaire.

diego_se: Nice. Are the spikes exact cron windows or fuzzy?

maria_sales: They gave precise windows: 09:57-10:00, 12:30-12:33, 15:49-15:52 (local TZ).

diego_se: Great — cron windows let us preheat. Quick recommendation: small reserved baseline for steady-state (2 A100-equiv) + a burst pool that can scale to ~18-20 A100-equiv for the short windows. Use preheat T-10m and spin burst T-2m.

harper_eng: sizing note: 1 A100-equiv ≈ 1.5k qps gen when quantized + batching. Embeddings on T4-equiv ≈ 3k qps. For their mix baseline = 2 A100 + 1 T4. Burst to 35k needs ~18 A100-equiv. We'll tune after rehearsals.

lina_sre: Ops checklist: 1) KV/prefix cache warm at T-10m, 2) autoscale caps and a fallback quantized model, 3) AZ placement same as baseline, 4) exportable audit log for preheat events.

omar_fin: Pricing: recommend hybrid — prorated baseline commit (2 GPUs) + burst-credit package (blocks of A100-min). I'll draft a POC quote for 30 days with 60m/day burst and post numbers.

harper_eng: sample autoscale snippet to include in runbook:
```yaml
autoscale:
  baseline_a100: "2"
  baseline_t4: "1"
  burst_max_a100: "20"
  preheat_minutes: "10"
  spinup_buffer: "2m"
  scale_up_thresh: "0.7"
  scale_down_cooldown: "8m"
  fallback_model: "gen-8bit-fallback-v1"
  kv_prefixes: ["market_open_prompts_v1"]
```

lina_sre: also add a rehearsal plan: two dry runs during low-risk hours to validate p99 and process. Capture queue depth and GPU util.

deigo_se: (typo) diego_se: will own runbook draft. maria_sales, can you confirm these cron windows with the customer and ask if they want preheat initiated by them or us?

maria_sales: will confirm and ask about KMS + SOC2 docs. They'll likely require customer-managed KMS for PHI.

deploy_bot: infra-bot: reserved-pool "finedge-poc" provisioning requested (baseline=2 A100-equiv, embeddings=1 T4-equiv, burst_cap=20 A100-equiv) by harper_eng at 2024-09-05T10:12:30Z :rocket:

omar_fin: I'll post the price stub by EOD.

diego_se: next steps summary: 1) confirm cron windows & who triggers preheat, 2) agree baseline commit + burst credit size, 3) schedule two rehearsals, 4) collect KMS/SOC2 answers. I'll attach runbook draft when ready.

maria_sales: thanks team — looping in security after customer reply. :thumbsup:
